class: A machine-wide 'work in flight' marker that records no owner makes every session on the machine obey every other session's marker: one session's long-running check blocks another session's unrelated writes, and no session can tell a live marker of its own from a peer's or a stale one.
mechanism: verifier_inflight_gate writes its snapshot under %TEMP%\verifier-write-guard\snap with no session id; while any session's verifier runs, every session's git worktree/commit/push is refused.

first_seen.where: GC-3L and the parallel GC-5S session on one laptop
first_seen.evidence: GC-3L's `git worktree add` refused three times ('A verifier tool call is running (snapshot 169s/174s/0s old)') while its own reviewer had finished; the snapshot (written 11:27) belonged to GC-5S's verifier; GC-5S reported the same block on its own pushes; resolved only by asking the peer session for a 10-minute window

fix: Not fixed (the gate is a project hook, scripts/hooks/verifier_inflight_gate.py). Class fix: the snapshot records the writing session id and the gate blocks only that session's writes (run-discipline E2: shared state records its owner).

detection.note: No test runs two sessions against the gate. Measured once, 2026-10-19.

occurrences.where: GC-3L close-out commit of the GC-3F review fixes
occurrences.evidence: three refusals, ~10 minutes, cleared by a peer-agreed window
